D012-D016_h001.question: It's been a tough few months since my wife passed. I've always loved being out in the woods, it's my life, but lately... things just feel different. I find myself freezing up when I hear a rustle in the bushes, or if a spider suddenly drops down in front of me. My heart just starts pounding out of my chest, and I feel a wave of dread wash over me. It happens so fast, I can barely breathe sometimes. I used to be able to handle anything the forest threw at me, but now, a simple buzzing sound near my ear can send me into a full-blown panic. I even get this tightness in my chest that doesn't let up. It’s making it hard to do my job, and honestly, hard to even enjoy the quiet peace I once found out there.

    B. Specific Phobia
    C. Bipolar II Disorder
    D. Schizophrenia

I know it sounds foolish for someone in my line of work, but it’s beyond my control at this point. It’s like something stops me from acting, almost like a command I can’t ignore."
